rv.q: Riotously entertaining revival of Peter Quilter’s play about Florence Foster Jenkins hits all the right notes at Manchester’s Hope Mill Theatre
Peters drives through the creakiness with enough eccentric vim.
Glorious! Is only playing at the Hope Mill till March 30th and should not be missed!
Peters succeeds in making the deranged diva remarkably loveable. Her comedic timing is incredible, with her comedy seen as much in her face as her voice.
